categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily manufactures rotary compressors used in household and commercial air conditioning, heat pump dryers, heat pump water heaters, and other heat pump applications. It also develops and sells heat pump water heating equipment for residential and commercial use. The business includes manufacturing, sales, and R&D of compressors and related products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company focuses on rotary compressor technology with applications in various refrigerants including R290 and R32. It develops variable frequency compressors with low noise and high efficiency, employing advanced motor designs such as 8-pole 12-slot low-noise motors. Production involves precision machining, assembly, testing, and coating processes, supported by ISO9001, ISO14001, ISO17025, and IATF16949 certifications.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are major air conditioning manufacturers globally, including markets in China, the United States, Europe, Southeast Asia, and Latin America. The company serves household air conditioning, commercial HVAC, heat pump appliances, and emerging sectors like base station air conditioning and automotive air conditioning. It has over 221 customers across 49 countries.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with significant sales in China (over 64% of revenue), the United States, Poland, Thailand, Indonesia, Italy, and other countries. It has manufacturing and joint ventures in China, India, and partnerships with international firms such as Daikin and Sharp. The product distribution covers Asia, North America, Europe, Latin America, and the Middle East.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment as a manufacturer of key components (rotary compressors) for air conditioning and heat pump systems. It collaborates closely with upstream raw material suppliers (copper wire, steel, magnets) and downstream OEM customers (air conditioner and appliance manufacturers).
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include developing differentiated, high-value compressors with enhanced energy efficiency and low global warming potential refrigerants (e.g., R290, R32). The company invests in variable frequency technology, low noise motors, and new product lines for heat pump dryers, dishwashers, and water heaters. It emphasizes sustainability, ESG integration, and compliance with evolving environmental regulations.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of compressors and heat pump equipment. The company also earns income from joint ventures and licensing arrangements. Sales are based on volume shipments to OEM customers worldwide, with a focus on expanding market share in emerging and high-efficiency product segments.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is ranked as the fourth largest global rotary compressor manufacturer with a global market share of about 8%. Major competitors include leading firms like Meizhi and Lingda, which dominate approximately 70% of the domestic market. The company competes by leveraging technology leadership, broad customer base, and expanding into new application areas.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In the latest fiscal year, the company achieved consolidated revenue of approximately NT$21.5 billion, a 27.6% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to the company of about NT$1 billion, up 34.2%. Sales volume of compressors reached 21.23 million units, growing nearly 37%. The company maintains a stable financial position with total assets near NT$29.9 billion and equity of NT$11.6 billion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, energy-efficient rotary compressors with advanced variable frequency technology and environmentally friendly refrigerants. It differentiates through customized solutions for diverse HVAC and heat pump applications, strong R&D capabilities, and compliance with global environmental standards. Its commitment to sustainability, innovation, and customer collaboration enhances competitive advantage.
